spec.source:
gantt
  dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
  axisFormat %d %b
  section One 45-day certificate
    First :c1, 2028-03-01 00:00, 1080h
    30-day rule, day 15 :fixed30, 2028-03-16 00:00, 1080h
    Default, day 30 :fraction, 2028-03-31 00:00, 1080h

limitations: Prepared occupied text regions bound native geometry; exact glyph ink depends on the resolved font.
Declared transparency, intentional data-mark overlap and externally modified CSS are outside this proof.
